user.title: Lite Resources
user.description: Set up Lite Resources. After this step, open the page of the integration: Settings, Devices & services, Lite Resources. There, select **Add group** in the upper-right corner, or in the three-dot menu of the entry. Add one group for each set of users (for example the logins of the wall panels of one room). Each group has its own dashboards. Everyone outside the groups keeps the normal behaviour.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Lite Resources is already set up.

user.title: Add a group of lite users
user.description: The users of a group load only the custom cards their dashboards use, and can receive live updates only for the entities on those dashboards. Both are worked out from the dashboards, and follow a dashboard when it is changed.

data.name: Group name
data.filter_states: Only send states their dashboards show
data.include_unscannable: Include resources that can't be checked

data_description.name: For example 'Workshop kiosks'.
data_description.users: These users get the reduced resource list and state stream on every device they log in on. A user can be in one group only.
data_description.dashboards: Every dashboard the users of this group open. The resources and the entities of these dashboards are found automatically.
data_description.filter_states: Stream live updates only for entities on their dashboards (plus group members). Big CPU saving on slow panels; other entities show as unavailable for these users.
data_description.extra_entities: Entities to keep streaming even though they aren't on the dashboards.
data_description.include_unscannable: Resources served by integrations or other sites can't be read; keep them loaded (recommended). A file named after a card these dashboards don't use is still skipped.
data_description.always_include: Leave empty: the needed resources are found from the dashboards. Add a resource only if a card fails to load, e.g. a mod used by a theme.
data_description.always_exclude: Leave empty normally. Resources to never load, even if a card seems to need them or they can't be checked. Wins over Always include.

reconfigure.title: Change a group of lite users
reconfigure.description: Open pages of the users of this group get the new entities at once. A page loads other custom cards when it is loaded again. To rename or delete the group, use the three-dot menu at the right of its row on the page of the integration.

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: For administrators. Show, for each group, which resources its users get and which are skipped, any card types no local resource was found for, and (if state filtering is on) which entities they receive. It also says why the states or the resources of a group are not narrowed.
